note: This mapping operationalizes the conceptual change-impact mechanism used in the manuscript. It does not define a universal M&S change taxonomy.
applicability_rule: evidence is directly reusable only when its typed dependencies do not intersect changed typed artifacts
contract_version_rule: evidence is bound to the exact contract version; a contract-version change makes dependent evidence non-active for the new configuration unless explicit compatibility evidence is supplied
capability_identity_rule: retain Capability_ID only when the trial-facing capability meaning remains materially unchanged; allocate a new Capability_ID when the capability meaning changes rather than only its implementation or contract representation
